name: Private Jet
summary: Small business jet in side view facing right, with rear engines and a T-tail; for luxury travel and airport scenes.

params.name: y
params.note: bottom of the craft (its gear) stands on y; it flies in the air above the ground

params.name: s
params.note: scale: about 720 px wide and 490 px tall at s = 1

params.name: anim
params.note: fly = gentle hover and the rear engine fan spins

params.name: vx
params.note: horizontal speed in px per frame (negative = left; set flip too)

params.name: flip
params.note: mirror so the jet faces left

author: krakujs
